name: Alstroemeria
source:
The grand magician of the realms. A powerful and intellectually playful Inflora faerie who serves as the court's Grandia Stella and protects the portal between faeries and mortals.

Likes: It's a lunar secret~

Dislikes: Counterfeit gold
